calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC 
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  o.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(*) as order_count,
  SUM(o.order_total_gross) as total_value
FROM fact_web_order o
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(o.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type

calls.statement:
WITH web_order_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    o.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(o.order_total_gross) as total_value
  FROM fact_web_order o
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(o.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_period,
    SUM(total_value) as period_total_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN total_value ELSE 0 END) as cac_value
  FROM web_order_periods
  GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * cac_value / period_total_value, 2) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM period_totals
ORDER BY fiscal_period

WITH web_order_periods AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    o.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(o.order_total_gross) as total_value
  FROM fact_web_order o
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(o.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_period,
    SUM(total_value) as period_total_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN total_value ELSE 0 END) as cac_value
  FROM web_order_periods
  GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * cac_value / period_total_value, 2) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM period_totals
ORDER BY fiscal_period
